sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports for the timer
sections.what: Brings in React's effect tool, the icons, the mode type, and the store.
sections.why: Needed for the timer's clock behavior, the icons and the data.

sections.name: TimerWidget (part 1)
sections.title: Timer tick and progress math
sections.what: While the timer runs, calls the store's tick action every second. Works out the total length from the mode and the percent done, and formats the time as minutes and seconds.
sections.why: Keeps the display in step with the store's clock.
sections.watch_out: The fifty, ten and thirty minute totals are fixed here, so they must change too if the store's durations change.

sections.name: TimerWidget (part 2)
sections.title: Mode buttons and progress ring
sections.what: Three buttons switch between sprint, short break and recovery. A ring around the countdown fills as time passes, with Focus In Progress or Paused text beneath the time.
sections.why: Shows the current state at a glance.
sections.watch_out: Only three modes have buttons, while the label list also includes a flowmodoro mode with no button to reach it.

sections.name: TimerWidget (part 3)
sections.title: Start, pause and reset buttons
sections.what: The big button toggles between pausing and starting focus, and the small button resets the timer.
sections.watch_out: Start here passes no title or length, so it uses whatever the store holds, which may differ from the desk room's fifty minute start.

summary: The round focus countdown with a progress ring, mode buttons, and start, pause and reset controls.
purpose: Let the user run a focus timer that counts down and shows how far through the session they are.
why: Likely reason: the timer state lives in the store so it keeps going across pages, and this widget only shows and controls it.
how: 1) While the timer is running, the store's tick action runs every second. 2) Works out the total length from the mode, and the percent done. 3) Formats the remaining time as minutes and seconds. 4) Shows mode buttons, the ring, and the start, pause and reset controls.
inputs: Timer state and actions from the store (running flag, time remaining, mode, task title, focus totals), and user clicks.
outputs: Changed timer state through store actions, and a visible countdown and ring.
risks: Total lengths are hardcoded per mode. The flowmodoro mode falls into the thirty minute case for the ring, so its progress is wrong. The start button passes no title or length, unlike the desk room.
debug: If the countdown stalls, check the running flag and the tick action in the store. If the ring looks wrong, check the total length used for the current mode. If mode labels look odd, check the mode value stored.
